name: update_cart_item_quantity
description: Changes the quantity of a product already in the cart by one unit, exactly like the +/- buttons on carrefour.it: decrease=false adds one, decrease=true removes one. Call it several times to change by more. Returns the cart lines and new total.

ean.description: EAN of a product already in the cart.

decrease.description: true to remove one unit, false to add one.

hints.NO_SHIPPING_METHOD_SELECTED: No delivery method is selected in this session, so carrefour.it cannot price or reserve the product. Select one first: find_stores with your CAP, then get_delivery_timeslots and reserve_delivery_timeslot for the store and method you want; then retry.
